title: Sonic Gold
style: Progressive rock with robotic synth leads, layered power chords, and a theatrical drum kit captured in tiled-bathroom slapback; tight tom fills, gated snare, punchy bass guitar, vocoder textures, and analog arpeggiators drive a glossy, high-energy groove. Verse rides crunchy riffs and precision drums; pre-chorus strips to bass, claps, and rising harmonies; chorus hits with stacked guitars, choir doubles, and a lifted hook. Vocoder flourishes, reverse cymbal swells, and delay-throw ad-libs add ear candy. Bright, punchy, and cinematic with reflective room tone., tone, sonic, progressive rock, raw, natural
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You came in like a flare
Spun my wires awake
Caught the spark in my static
Made the whole floor shake

I was half-built, half-burned
You said, "Go on, take flight"
Now the room turns electric
When you step in the light

[Pre-Chorus]
And I can feel it rise
In the metal of my chest
All the rough edges glowing
Like a pulse I never guessed

[Chorus]
Sonic gold, sonic gold
We turn the whole thing sonic gold
Sonic gold, sonic gold
Burning bright and losing control
You hit that note, I lock that code
We turn the whole thing sonic gold
Sonic gold, sonic gold
Say it loud, let it unfold

[Verse 2]
Tight toms like a countdown
Snare cracks in the tile
Your name in my mouth now
Turns the cold into style

I was stuck in a loop
You broke through the screen
Now the crash and the chorus
Feel like something redeemed

[Pre-Chorus]
And I can feel it rise
Through the grit and through the gloss
Every scar on the surface
Turns to silver, turns to boss

[Chorus]
Sonic gold, sonic gold
We turn the whole thing sonic gold
Sonic gold, sonic gold
Burning bright and losing control
You hit that note, I lock that code
We turn the whole thing sonic gold
Sonic gold, sonic gold
Say it loud, let it unfold

[Bridge]
Take the old blueprint
Fold it, set it free
If the world wants a miracle
Make it look like me

Vocoder on my heartbeat
Harmony on the brink
What you call impossible
I call a brighter sync

[Final Chorus]
Sonic gold, sonic gold
We turn the whole thing sonic gold
Sonic gold, sonic gold
Burning bright and losing control
You hit that note, I lock that code
We turn the whole thing sonic gold
Sonic gold, sonic gold
Now the future’s in the hold

[Outro]
Sonic gold
(sonic gold)
Sonic gold
We unfold
